title: Overlays
summary: Shared pieces: drawn once, worn by every theme (its colours, fonts and card style from theme.json "look"). A theme's own piece of the same name wins.

items.name: Stat card
items.description: A card with one big number that counts up and a label under it; an accent bar fills to the percentage. Props: value, prefix, suffix, label, decimals, x, y (top-left), w.

items.name: Hand-drawn circle
items.description: A pen circle that draws itself around a word, number or button, in the theme's accent. Props: x, y (centre), w, h (size of the thing circled), at, draw (seconds), width. Never around the face.

items.name: Full-screen picture, slow push
items.description: A still picture filling the frame (cover-cropped) with a slow push-in, for a full-screen cutaway of a contact sheet, poster or screenshot. Props: src, zoom [from, to], focus [x, y] (0..1), fadeIn, ease ('linear' | 'inout'). Use with "cutaway": true.

items.name: Glass of water, draining or filling
items.description: A drinking glass whose water level moves between two fills with a rippling surface and bubbles; a small line above, a big label landing under it. Levels show a state, no figures are printed. Props: from, to (0..1), at, dur, kicker, label, labelAt, warn (label in the accent), pour (a stream falls in while it fills), color (the water; the accent by default), cx, top, w, h.

items.name: Stick figure, stiff to stretched
items.description: A front-on stick figure moving between two poses, 'stiff' (hunched, arms tucked in) and 'reach' (tall, arms overhead); a small line above, a big label landing under it. Shows a state, no figures are printed. Props: from, to (pose names), at, dur, kicker, label, labelAt, warn (pulsing marks on neck, back and knees; label in the accent), flow (dots run out along the limbs from flowAt), color (marks and dots; the accent by default), cx, ground, scale.

items.name: Window, curtains opening to the sun
items.description: A window whose curtains slide open while the sun rises behind the glass and its rays turn on, daylight spilling under the sill; a small line above, a big label landing under it. How far the curtains are open shows a state, no figures are printed. Props: from, to (0..1 open), at, dur, kicker, label, labelAt, warn (label in the accent), color (the sun and daylight; the accent by default), cx, top, w, h.

items.name: Pick grid
items.description: A grid of numbered option tiles for 'many options, pick one': tiles pop in, one lights up in the accent while the rest dim, then a few more light up crooked; a mono readout counts the picks (14 WAYS, 1 OF 14, 6 OF 14). Props: count, cols, x, y (top-left), w, one, oneAt, many, manyAt, manyStep, unit.

items.name: Name tag (HELLO, my name is)
items.description: A 'HELLO, my name is' sticker badge: the name writes on, can slip away and be replaced (forgetAt + after, e.g. '???'), and a drawn rose can bloom on its corner (bloom [from, to]) for turning a name into a picture; a small line above, a big label landing under it. Props: name, at, dur, forgetAt, after, kicker, label, labelAt, warn, bloom, bloomAt, bloomDur, color, leaf, tilt, enter, cx, top, w, h.

items.name: Speech bubbles (a short exchange)
items.description: A short spoken exchange as speech bubbles, the other person on the left and the reply on the right, each popping in from its tail at its moment; one marked word per line is drawn in the accent and underlined. A small line above, a big label under. Props: lines [{text, side, at, mark}], size, top, gap, max, kicker, label, labelAt, labelY, warn.
